prompt: who won the formula one season in the year nine people were killed on the track at the argentine grand prix, and how old were they two years before sliced bread was first sold?
answer: Alberto Ascari won the 1953 Formula One season. Since sliced bread was first sold in 1928, two years earlier was 1926; Ascari, born on July 13, 1918, was **7 years old** then (turning 8 that July).
